questions.prompt: Muhungu wanjye, ntukwiriye kurya ibyokurya biri munsi ya kiriya kirago
questions.answer: My son, you mustn't eat the food that is beneath that rug.

questions.prompt: Kiriya kiragi kiricara mu gicucu cy'igiti
questions.answer: That dumb person is sitting in the shade of the tree.

questions.prompt: Ndi umuntu w'imbaraga nyinshi, ariko sinshobora guhindura ibyaha byanjye
questions.answer: I'm a very strong person, but I can't change my sins.

questions.prompt: Sindeba icyuma cye; kiri munsi y'ikirago cyawe
questions.answer: I'm not looking at his knife; it's beneath your rug.

questions.prompt: Ibyokurya byiza ntibishobora guhindura umutima w'umuntu mubi
questions.answer: Good food is not able to change the heart of a bad person

questions.prompt: Sinshobora kurya ibijumba kuko dufite ibigori bisa. Iyi minsi ibyokurya ni bikeya cyane
questions.answer: I'm not able to eat sweet potatoes because we have corn only. These days food is very scarce.

questions.prompt: Aba bagabo ntibashobora gukora neza. Bose n'imumyi n'ibiragi
questions.answer: These men are not able to work well. They are all blind and dumb (men).

questions.prompt: Nshuti yanjye, ndagushimye cyane. Urumfasha kuba umuntu mushya.
questions.answer: My friend, I thank you very much. You are helping me to be a new person.

questions.prompt: Mbese ibitabo byawe bishya bari hehe? Biri hanze munsi y'igiti. Hari igicucu cyiza munsi ya kiriya giti.
questions.answer: Where are your new books? They are outside under the tree. There is a good shadow under the tree.
